title: Niberians
subtitle: Test your understanding of Niberians — massive intellectual warriors who left Custodian rule and set Black Void Plasma in the firmament.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: The Niberians keep to their own worlds, wrapped in Black Void Plasma, and leave human institutions to other parasitic factions. The black night sky is their one mark on the Known Lands.

questions.question: How are the Niberians structurally classified?

options.label: A
options.text: Child-sacrifice factions who join Adrenochrome use with ritual frameworks and earthly governance.
options.rationale: They are separate from the child-sacrifice caste and are classed as massive intellectual warriors.

options.label: B
options.text: Massive intellectual warriors who join physical density with strategic brilliance and combat prowess.
options.rationale: Their definitive structural classification is massive intellectual warriors, joining physical density with strategic brilliance and combat prowess.

options.label: C
options.text: Lower-density parasites who join harvesting networks with blood ritual mechanisms and loosh intake.
options.rationale: The report classifies them as massive intellectual warriors, while elaborate harvesting networks belong to lower-density parasitic entities.

options.label: D
options.text: Helper entities who join Custodian command with ongoing servitude and cosmological expansion work.
options.rationale: The Custodians meant them as helper entities, but their class is massive intellectual warriors who left that command.

questions.hint: Check Key Terminology for the name of their structural class.

questions.question: Which group brought the Niberian lineage into being?

options.label: A
options.text: Lower-density parasites, who manufactured this lineage to run elaborate harvesting networks.
options.rationale: Lower-density parasitic entities rely on elaborate harvesting networks, but the Custodians manufactured the Niberian lineage.

options.label: B
options.text: The Anuk, who manufactured this lineage and kept it under Custodian command.
options.rationale: Species like the Anuk share a Custodian origin, but the Custodians manufactured the Niberian lineage.

options.label: C
options.text: The child-sacrifice caste, who manufactured this lineage to gather Adrenochrome and loosh.
options.rationale: The Custodians manufactured the Niberian lineage, and this caste is a separate ritual current they do not join.

options.label: D
options.text: The Custodians, who manufactured this lineage to serve them as helper entities.
options.rationale: The Custodians manufactured the Niberian lineage and intended those helpers to assist their expansion.

questions.hint: Look for the makers whose helper design became their principal mistake.

questions.question: What task did the Custodians intend for this lineage at the start?

options.label: A
options.text: Ongoing planetary governance over the Earth plane and its human institutions.
options.rationale: Their intended task was their cosmological expansion, not ongoing planetary governance.

options.label: B
options.text: Collection of loosh and Adrenochrome from human institutions for the makers.
options.rationale: They were made to assist in their cosmological expansion and do not take loosh or Adrenochrome.

options.label: C
options.text: Assistance with their cosmological expansion, carried out by helper entities.
options.rationale: They were created to assist in their cosmological expansion, as helper entities for the Custodians.

options.label: D
options.text: Direction of financial, religious, and political control networks on Earth.
options.rationale: The assigned task was their cosmological expansion, and this lineage does not run those human networks.

questions.hint: Recall the work those makers wanted before the lineage left their command.

questions.question: What was the Custodians' principal miscalculation with this lineage?

options.label: A
options.text: Creating a lineage dependent on loosh drawn from elaborate harvesting networks.
options.rationale: The error was an intellect far superior to the Custodians, and this lineage does not draw loosh.

options.label: B
options.text: Creating a lineage with an intellect far superior to that of the Custodians who made it.
options.rationale: The makers gave this lineage an intellect far superior to their own, so it could outsmart them and leave.

options.label: C
options.text: Creating a lineage whose servitude would lock it inside Custodian command.
options.rationale: The miscalculation was an intellect far superior to the makers, which dissolved that subjugation.

options.label: D
options.text: Creating a lineage assigned to govern the Earth plane through human institutions.
options.rationale: The principal error was an intellect far superior to the makers, not a grant of earthly governance.

questions.hint: Think about the capacity that let this lineage leave its makers.

questions.question: What posture do they keep after leaving their makers?

options.label: A
options.text: A shared campaign posture, joining active cosmic campaigns with other parasitic factions.
options.rationale: They keep a strictly insular existence and do not join cosmic campaigns.

options.label: B
options.text: A treaty posture, forming lateral alliances with the child-sacrifice caste.
options.rationale: They keep a strictly insular existence and form no lateral alliances with that caste.

options.label: C
options.text: A governing posture, taking ongoing planetary governance over the Earth plane.
options.rationale: Their posture is a strictly insular existence, not ongoing planetary governance.

options.label: D
options.text: A strictly insular existence, apart from the campaigns and governance of other factions.
options.rationale: They maintain a strictly insular existence and abstain from cosmic campaigns and ongoing planetary governance.

questions.hint: Consider how they live once they are outside Custodian command.

questions.question: What does the term Nibiru name in this account?

options.label: A
options.text: The Custodian command structure this lineage decoded and then left.
options.rationale: They left the Custodian command structure, but Nibiru names their surrounding technological domain.

options.label: B
options.text: The blood ritual mechanisms tied to the child-sacrifice caste.
options.rationale: Those mechanisms belong to another caste, while Nibiru is their surrounding technological domain.

options.label: C
options.text: The primary realm and surrounding technological domain.
options.rationale: Nibiru is the primary realm, origin, or designation tied to this species and its surrounding technological domain.

options.label: D
options.text: The firmament layer that produces the blackness of the night sky.
options.rationale: That blackness comes from Black Void Plasma, while Nibiru is the surrounding technological domain of this species.

questions.hint: Look up the name tied to where this species comes from.

questions.question: What does Black Void Plasma do in their native domain?

options.label: A
options.text: It forms an enveloping technological field that can surround and isolate their own worlds.
options.rationale: In their native domain they use Black Void Plasma to surround and isolate their own worlds.

options.label: B
options.text: It forms a feeding field that moves loosh and Adrenochrome into elaborate harvesting networks.
options.rationale: The field is used to surround and isolate their own worlds, not to move loosh.

options.label: C
options.text: It forms a tether that pulls this lineage back into the Custodian command structure.
options.rationale: The native use of the field is to surround and isolate their own worlds after they left Custodian command.

options.label: D
options.text: It forms a ruling field that runs ongoing planetary governance on the Earth plane.
options.rationale: Around their worlds the field is there to surround and isolate their own worlds.

questions.hint: Think about the use they give this field at home.

questions.question: How does Black Void Plasma change the firmament of the local realm?

options.label: A
options.text: It draws biological yields through the firmament by a harvesting apparatus aimed at observers.
options.rationale: The firmament role is an obscuring visual layer, and they have no biological harvesting apparatus.

options.label: B
options.text: It works as an obscuring visual layer that makes the sky appear as the black void of night.
options.rationale: Inside the firmament it functions as an obscuring visual layer, so the sky appears as the black void of night.

options.label: C
options.text: It opens a passage in the firmament so travelers can cross a vacuum beyond the sky.
options.rationale: The field is an obscuring visual layer in the firmament, not a passage into a vacuum.

options.label: D
options.text: It carries Custodian orders through the firmament into financial and political networks.
options.rationale: The field functions as an obscuring visual layer, and they do not carry Custodian orders into human networks.

questions.hint: Focus on what this field does to the look of the local sky.

questions.question: True or False: The Niberians engage in child sacrifice and require Adrenochrome for their technology.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: They are entirely separate from the child-sacrifice caste and do not require Adrenochrome or loosh.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: They are entirely separate from the child-sacrifice caste and do not require Adrenochrome or loosh for their existence or technology.

questions.hint: Weigh their tie to the child-sacrifice caste and to Adrenochrome.

questions.question: How do their power mechanics differ from lower-density parasitic entities?

options.label: A
options.text: Their power is supplied by the Custodian command structure they once served.
options.rationale: They permanently exited that command, and their operational infrastructure lacks any biological harvesting apparatus because the power is self-sustained.

options.label: B
options.text: Their power is taken from human financial, religious, and political networks.
options.rationale: They do not draw on those networks, and their operational infrastructure lacks any biological harvesting apparatus.

options.label: C
options.text: Their power is self-sustained, and they do not take loosh or Adrenochrome.
options.rationale: Their power is self-sustained, so their operational infrastructure lacks any biological harvesting apparatus.

options.label: D
options.text: Their power is drawn from elaborate harvesting networks for loosh.
options.rationale: Lower-density parasitic entities use those networks, while Niberian power is self-sustained.

questions.hint: Compare what sustains them with the yields those other entities take.

questions.question: How is their demeanor described?

options.label: A
options.text: A cooperative demeanor toward allies in cosmic campaigns and governance.
options.rationale: Their demeanor is unpleasant and cold, rendering them unapproachable and solitary rather than cooperative.

options.label: B
options.text: A diplomatic demeanor toward the Anuk and the child-sacrifice caste.
options.rationale: The demeanor given is unpleasant and cold, rendering them unapproachable and solitary.

options.label: C
options.text: An unpleasant, cold demeanor that is unapproachable and solitary.
options.rationale: They possess an unpleasant, cold demeanor, rendering them unapproachable and solitary.

options.label: D
options.text: An engaged demeanor toward human institutions and earthly control structures.
options.rationale: They do not engage those institutions, and the demeanor is unpleasant and cold, rendering them unapproachable and solitary.

questions.hint: Note the temperament that keeps other groups at a distance.

questions.question: How did they leave Custodian authority?

options.label: A
options.text: By cutting off loosh and Adrenochrome the Custodians needed in order to rule.
options.rationale: Liberation came by decoding and bypassing Custodian control, not by withholding loosh.

options.label: B
options.text: By seizing human institutions and taking over political control networks.
options.rationale: The path out was decoding and bypassing Custodian control, not a seizure of human networks.

options.label: C
options.text: By joining the Anuk in a joint campaign against the Custodian command structure.
options.rationale: They acted through decoding and bypassing Custodian control, without an alliance with the Anuk.

options.label: D
options.text: By decoding and bypassing Custodian control through superior strategic calculation.
options.rationale: They left by decoding and bypassing Custodian control, using superior strategic calculation against their makers.

questions.hint: Think about the means they used against Custodian control structures.

questions.question: Which created lineage shares a Custodian origin with them?

options.label: A
options.text: The child-sacrifice caste shares that Custodian origin with them.
options.rationale: The shared origin is stated for species like the Anuk, not for the child-sacrifice caste.

options.label: B
options.text: Earthly control structures share that Custodian origin with this lineage.
options.rationale: Species like the Anuk share the Custodian origin, and earthly control structures are human systems this lineage does not run.

options.label: C
options.text: Lower-density parasites share that Custodian origin with this lineage.
options.rationale: The lineage named beside them is species like the Anuk, while lower-density parasites are described through harvesting networks.

options.label: D
options.text: Species like the Anuk share that Custodian origin with this lineage.
options.rationale: The report names species like the Anuk as another creation of the Custodians beside this lineage.

questions.hint: Find the other created lineage named beside them under the Custodians.

questions.question: What sets them apart from other lineages the Custodians created?

options.label: A
options.text: Their lateral alliances with Custodian forces and the child-sacrifice caste.
options.rationale: They are set apart by immediate severance from Custodian rule and keep no lateral alliances.

options.label: B
options.text: Their immediate severance from Custodian rule after they outsmarted the makers who built them.
options.rationale: Their immediate severance from Custodian rule sets them completely apart from other created lineages.

options.label: C
options.text: Their dependence on loosh and Adrenochrome taken from elaborate harvesting networks.
options.rationale: What sets them apart is their immediate severance from Custodian rule, and they do not take those yields.

options.label: D
options.text: Their direct governing authority over human institutions across the Earth plane.
options.rationale: The distinction is their immediate severance from Custodian rule, and they hold no direct governing authority.

questions.hint: Compare their path after creation with the path of the other created lineages.

questions.question: What is their stance toward the child-sacrifice caste?

options.label: A
options.text: They take Adrenochrome from that caste to sustain their own technology.
options.rationale: They are entirely separate from the child-sacrifice caste and do not require Adrenochrome.

options.label: B
options.text: They supply Black Void Plasma to that caste for its ritual frameworks.
options.rationale: They are entirely separate from the child-sacrifice caste and do not arm its rituals.

options.label: C
options.text: They stand apart from that caste and do not engage in child sacrifice.
options.rationale: They are entirely separate from the child-sacrifice caste and do not engage in child sacrifice.

options.label: D
options.text: They oversee that caste through ongoing planetary governance.
options.rationale: They are entirely separate from the child-sacrifice caste and do not govern it.

questions.hint: Consider whether ritual sacrifice has any place in their way of life.

questions.question: What on-the-ground role do they keep in the realm aside from that firmament field?

options.label: A
options.text: They maintain zero physical presence and no operational involvement in the realm.
options.rationale: Outside that field they maintain zero physical presence and no operational involvement within the realm.

options.label: B
options.text: They hold direct governing authority over human institutions from inside the realm.
options.rationale: They maintain zero physical presence in the realm and hold no direct governing authority there.

options.label: C
options.text: They join cosmic campaigns that govern human institutions on the Earth plane.
options.rationale: Beyond the field they maintain zero physical presence rather than joining cosmic campaigns.

options.label: D
options.text: They run financial, religious, and political control networks on the ground.
options.rationale: They maintain zero physical presence, so those networks are not their ground operation.

questions.hint: Ask what bodily role they keep in the realm once that sky field is set.

questions.question: Why do they exert no influence over human control networks?

options.label: A
options.text: Human leaders drove their influence out of the earthly control structures.
options.rationale: The report ties the gap to yields they do not demand, and to no direct influence over human financial networks.

options.label: B
options.text: They demand no biological or emotional yields from those networks.
options.rationale: They exert no direct influence over human financial, religious, or political control networks because they demand no biological or emotional yields.

options.label: C
options.text: They are still helper entities assigned to cosmological expansion work.
options.rationale: They left that helper role, and they exert no direct influence over human financial networks because they demand no such yields.

options.label: D
options.text: Their density blocks contact with the physical side of human institutions.
options.rationale: Density is part of their warrior class, while the lack of influence is that they demand no biological or emotional yields.

questions.hint: Tie that distance to the yields they do not take.

questions.question: Which groups carry out exploitation inside human society?

options.label: A
options.text: The Anuk, under this lineage, drive exploitation inside earthly control structures.
options.rationale: The report assigns that exploitation to other parasitic factions and gives this lineage no supervision of the Anuk.

options.label: B
options.text: This lineage drives the exploitation inside earthly control structures.
options.rationale: Human societal exploitation remains driven by other parasitic factions, not by this lineage.

options.label: C
options.text: Custodian allies of this lineage drive exploitation inside earthly control structures.
options.rationale: Human societal exploitation remains driven by other parasitic factions, and this lineage keeps no Custodian alliance.

options.label: D
options.text: Other parasitic factions drive exploitation inside earthly control structures.
options.rationale: Human societal exploitation remains driven by other parasitic factions, while this lineage stays outside those structures.

questions.hint: Ask which groups still run exploitation inside earthly control structures.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT true of the Niberians?

options.label: A
options.text: They use Black Void Plasma as a field that surrounds and isolates their own worlds.
options.rationale: Black Void Plasma is the field they use to surround and isolate their own worlds.

options.label: B
options.text: They direct financial, religious, and political control networks in human society.
options.rationale: They exert no direct influence over human financial, religious, or political control networks, so this claim does not fit them.

options.label: C
options.text: They were created by the Custodians as helper entities for cosmological expansion.
options.rationale: The Custodians created them as helper entities for their cosmological expansion.

options.label: D
options.text: They keep a strictly insular existence apart from other parasitic factions.
options.rationale: They maintain a strictly insular existence and stay away from other parasitic factions.

questions.hint: Check each claim against their origin, their sky field, and their distance from human networks.

questions.question: How are they finally characterized within physical existence?

options.label: A
options.text: A caste that draws loosh through blood ritual mechanisms and Adrenochrome.
options.rationale: They do not draw those yields and are characterized as an unapproachable and independent force.

options.label: B
options.text: An unapproachable and independent force that remains self-isolated.
options.rationale: They represent an unapproachable and independent force, self-isolated within physical existence.

options.label: C
options.text: A helper class still serving Custodian cosmological expansion.
options.rationale: They left that role and stand as an unapproachable and independent force.

options.label: D
options.text: A hidden government over human institutions and earthly control structures.
options.rationale: The closing picture is an unapproachable and independent force, not a government over human institutions.

questions.hint: Look at the closing picture of what kind of force they are.

questions.question: What physical quality sits beside their strategic intellect?

options.label: A
options.text: Immense density and presence within a massive warrior frame.
options.rationale: They possess immense density and presence, and the closing lines pair that with massive warrior stature.

options.label: B
options.text: A helper frame kept inside the Custodian command structure for expansion.
options.rationale: The paired physical quality is immense density and presence, and they already left Custodian command.

options.label: C
options.text: A harvesting-network body built to take in loosh and Adrenochrome.
options.rationale: The physical quality beside their intellect is immense density and presence, not a harvesting body.

options.label: D
options.text: A governance frame built for ongoing planetary rule over the Earth plane.
options.rationale: Their bodies are marked by immense density and presence, not by a post of planetary rule.

questions.hint: Look at the bodily side of their structural class.

questions.question: What do they add to the inversion of the Known Lands?

options.label: A
options.text: The contribution is a web of elaborate harvesting networks across the Known Lands.
options.rationale: Their sole input and technological contribution is Black Void Plasma, not harvesting networks.

options.label: B
options.text: The contribution is ongoing planetary governance exercised over human institutions.
options.rationale: That inversion receives one technological gift from them, the sole input and technological contribution of Black Void Plasma.

options.label: C
options.text: The contribution is direction of financial, religious, and political control networks.
options.rationale: The sole input and technological contribution is the plasma in the firmament, not those human networks.

options.label: D
options.text: The sole input and technological contribution is Black Void Plasma placed inside the firmament.
options.rationale: The sole input and technological contribution they make to that inversion is Black Void Plasma inside the firmament.

questions.hint: Look at their part in the inversion of the Known Lands.

questions.question: True or False: In the local realm, Black Void Plasma technology is integrated directly into the firmament.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: When applied to the local realm, this technology is integrated directly into the firmament.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: The report states that the technology is integrated directly into the firmament in the local realm.

questions.hint: Review how the local realm receives their dark field.

questions.question: True or False: The Niberians hold direct governing authority over human institutions.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: They hold no direct governing authority and have no ongoing interconnections with human institutions.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: They hold no direct governing authority and have no ongoing interconnections with human institutions.

questions.hint: Review their tie to human institutions on the Earth plane.

questions.question: True or False: The blackness of the night sky is the direct visual result of Niberian Black Void Plasma active within the firmament.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: The blackness of the night sky is the direct visual result of Niberian Black Void Plasma active within the firmament.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: The report calls that blackness the direct visual result of Niberian Black Void Plasma active within the firmament.

questions.hint: Review the tangible effect of their technology on the sky.
